claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Sweet 16 and Elite Eight rounds will be held at Toyota Center in Houston for the South Regional.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Sweet 16 and Elite Eight rounds will be held at SAP Center in San Jose, Calif. for the West Regional.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Sweet 16 and Elite Eight rounds will be held at United Center in Chicago for the Midwest Regional.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament Sweet 16 and Elite Eight rounds will be held at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C. for the East Regional.
Sweet 16 games are scheduled for March 26-27, 2026.
Elite Eight games are scheduled for March 28-29, 2026.
The 2026 Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN.
The SAP Center in San Jose is known for its steep, high-action seating.
